author: Jason Aycock
title: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is launching a free repair program to
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is launching a free repair program to address a component failure afflicting a "small percentage" of iPhone 7 devices.
That's the fourth official iPhone repair program since 2015.
A failure on the phone's main logic board makes the status bar show that the phone isn't connected to cell networks even when service is available, the company says.
The phones were sold from September 2016 to February 2018 in China, Hong Kong, Japan, Macau and the U.S.
Shares closed down 4.3% today; they're trading down 0.2% after hours.
